note: Golden fixtures (M1.11). Each fixture states an input and the expected KB verdict. Sources of truth for expected values: PRD section 24 scenarios + verified KB facts (rules E001-E006, financial bounds, activity mapping status). UNVERIFIED mapping constraints are reflected, never hidden.

records.name: PRD hero demo: tailoring entrepreneur (ranked NSFDC-TL)

expected.notes: PRD sec 24 hero: Rs 3L tailoring / Rs 3.5L income -> NSFDC-TL (PRD score 94; Ranking is PRD scoring, not a rule). KB rule facts: income <= 5L (E002), SC (E001); TL cost >1.4L and <=50L holds; UNY (max 5L) also matches as a rule matter. MFS/AMY excluded: cost > 1.4L cap. Activity verification: Tailoring IS in Service & Transport taxonomy; activity->scheme mapping remains UNVERIFIED (DQ-012) and must be surfaced as such in UI.

records.basis: PRD sec 24 hero scenario; E001/E002; TL cost bound (>1.4L, <=50L); Service & Transport taxonomy contains Tailoring (S004); mapping UNVERIFIED (DQ-012).

records.name: Income boundary: exactly at the 5 lakh ceiling

expected.notes: E002 operator is <=; exactly 5,00,000 passes. Project cost 1L: eligible under MFS/AMY (max 1.4L) and UNY (max 5L); TL requires > 1.4L and fails.

records.basis: E002 operator is <= (inclusive at 5,00,000); cost bounds MFS/AMY max 1.4L, UNY max 5L; TL exclusive lower bound excludes cost 1L.

records.name: Income boundary: one rupee above the ceiling

expected.notes: E002 strict: Rs 5,00,001 exceeds the Rs 5,00,000 ceiling -> all 5 core schemes ineligible.

records.basis: E002 strict: 5,00,001 exceeds ceiling; every core scheme fails.

records.name: Term Loan upper loan boundary

expected.notes: TL project cost 40L (max 50L). Loan = 90% finance = 36L (max 45L) -> passes. UNY excluded: cost > 5L cap. ELS excluded: not an education case.

records.basis: TL bounds: cost 40L (max 50L); loan = 90% x 40L = 36L <= 45L; UNY cost cap 5L excludes.

records.name: Term Loan exclusive lower bound

expected.notes: Cost exactly 1.40L: TL is EXCLUDED (exclusive > 1.4L, DQ-001). MFS/AMY (max 1.4L, inclusive unknown) and UNY (max 5L) accept; boundary inclusivity of MFS/AMY max is PARTIAL and should present as such.

records.basis: TL lower bound exclusive (>1.4L) excludes cost exactly 1.4L (DQ-001); MFS/AMY Snapshot wording up to 1.4L supports inclusive; UNY max 5L.

records.name: Supported activity within multiple schemes

expected.notes: Fisheries is in Agricultural & Allied taxonomy (S004). Three micro schemes accept 1L projects; scoring/ranking is PRD factor (not a rule) so all three appear as matches.

records.basis: Fisheries in Agricultural & Allied taxonomy (S004); micro schemes accept 1L projects; E002 passes.

records.name: Unsupported activity (not in taxonomy)

expected.notes: 'Cinema Hall' is not in the NSFDC Indicative Activities taxonomy (S004). No scheme can claim it is financed; eligibility status UNKNOWN (do not silently treat as eligible).

records.basis: Cinema Hall not in Indicative Activities taxonomy (S004); KB cannot claim eligibility.

records.name: No matching scheme: non-SC applicant

expected.notes: E001 community must_be SC fails -> no core scheme applies. (NSFDC is exclusive to SC beneficiaries per mandate.)

records.basis: E001 community must be SC; fails for all schemes.

records.name: Missing information: income not provided

expected.notes: E002 cannot be evaluated without income. Engine MUST ask for income; it may not infer or assume a default.

records.basis: E002 not evaluable without annual_family_income; engine must ask, not assume.

records.name: Education: B.Tech student covered course

expected.notes: B.Tech is CF-001 Engineering (covered list S001). Income <= 5L. Cap = min(40L, 90% of 30L = 27L) = 27L. Repayment not started -> 12 years; moratorium = course period + 1 year (course period not in KB, user input needed).

records.basis: CF-001 Engineering in ELS covered list (S001); ELS cap formula min(40L, 90% x 30L)=27L; E002 passes.

records.name: Education: course not in covered list

expected.notes: 'Astrology' is not among the 25 ELS covered course families (education.json). ELS course-coverage check fails; do not fabricate coverage.

records.basis: Astrology not among 25 ELS covered families (education.json); ELS course-coverage check fails; income schemes excluded by project cost 1 crore.
